# The Lily Pad

> All-in-one NFT launchpad, marketplace, and live streaming platform for creators on Solana and Monad. Mint collections, stream live, accept SOL tips, and grow a community.

The Lily Pad (also called Lily Launchpad) lets creators launch NFT collections with advanced trait rules, candy guards, allowlists, and rarity tiers, then sell and trade them in the built-in marketplace. Streamers can go live, take crypto tips, and reward holders.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform, featured collections, and live streams.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Browse NFT collections, listings, and sticker packs across Solana and Monad.
- [Live Streams](/streams): Watch live creator streams, mint events, and community broadcasts.
- [Streamers](/streamers): Discover creators and follow your favorites.
- [Launchpad](/launchpad): Launch a new NFT collection with traits, rarity, and candy-guard mint phases.

## Optional

- [Apply as a Streamer](/streamer/apply): Application page for new creators.
